name: a note with two prerequisites makes the problem a DAG, solved exactly by branch and bound, read in Kahn order
why: top needs left and right, both need base: not a forest, so branch and bound. All four fit in 8 minutes (value 19). Rank: base 0, left 1, top 2 (first reached from left), right 3. Reading order is Kahn's algorithm taking the ready note of smallest rank: base; then left (1) before right (3); top only after right. So base, left, right, top, which differs from rank order.
